prompt: Create a single standalone decorative circuit illustration asset for a refined technology company website. Sophisticated flat 2D engineering line illustration with consistent thin strokes, delicate pale blue auxiliary traces and restrained cobalt blue and cyan highlights. No text, letters, numbers, user interface, border or background. Keep the entire connected circuit low-density, clean, elegant and suitable for placement in an empty margin below paragraph text.
